name: Ryan Hausknecht
biography: Ryan Hausknecht is the Director of Research at BeyondTrust Phantom Labs. Ryan has an extensive background in red teaming, detection development, and security research through his tenure at Microsoft and Specterops. His most notable contibutions have been in cloud security as the creator of PowerZure, the Azure Threat Research Matrix, and as the co-author of AzureHound.
